answer: Admit each new address over one whisper pipe: a private ordered lane with one established agent, who locks 45 POA slashed if the recruit is later proven cloned. Two angle-lit photos of an opal cabochon the introducer holds are hashed into the channel id, so that stone cannot open a second lane. Quota resets when a public phenology feed reports yarrow blooming in their region, about once a summer. One pipe and one stone underwrite one recruit. Protocol constant: 45 POA a side; eighty fakes freeze 7,200 POA and need eighty counterparts and stones.
